description: This file defines a utility class 'QueueHelper' for managing media playback queues in an Android media application. It includes methods to generate queues based on media IDs, searches, and genres, as well as utility functions to find item indices within queues.

classes.name: QueueHelper
classes.description: Utility class for managing media playback queue operations such as creating, retrieving, and searching queues.

methods.name: getPlayingQueue
methods.description: Generates a playback queue based on a media ID and music provider, supporting genre and search categories.

methods.name: getPlayingQueueFromSearch
methods.description: Creates a playback queue based on a search query.

methods.name: getMusicIndexOnQueue
methods.description: Finds the index of a media item in the queue by media ID.

methods.name: getMusicIndexOnQueue
methods.description: Finds the index of a media item in the queue by queue ID.

methods.name: convertToQueue
methods.description: Converts a list of MediaMetadata tracks into a playback queue, embedding hierarchy-aware media IDs.

methods.name: getRandomQueue
methods.description: Creates a queue using the first available genre from the music provider.

methods.name: isIndexPlayable
methods.description: Checks if a given index is valid and playable within the queue.
